To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) training a model on synthetic data only leads to a worse performance than training on real data only; (ii) training on both real and synthetic data is better than training on real only, but the best performance is obtained by training on real data with synthetic data augmentation.

the use of synthetic soundscapes for sound event detection training, when done correctly, can be beneficial and that the use of a teacher-student model can improve the results of sound event detection.

the mean teacher algorithm is a powerful technique for training a sound event detection system on heterogeneous datasets and that the use of a synthetic data generator that can be trained to mimic the distribution of the real data can be used to reduce the need to use large amounts of real data for training.
